1.headline: Built for merchants. Designed for growth.

v1.caption:
Most commerce platforms are built first for the platform's own growth, with merchants treated as the supply that makes it work. KAELUM was built the other way round. Every mechanic, from the 6% minimum customer discount to K.A.T.E.'s Merchant Performance agent, exists to grow the merchant's business first.

That is not altruism, it is the only model that actually scales sustainably. A commerce currency only works if the merchants accepting it are genuinely better off for doing so.

v2.caption:
Growth for the platform and growth for the merchant are not automatically the same thing, and most commerce infrastructure has quietly optimised for the former. KAELUM was designed for the latter, built for merchants, with growth as the measurable outcome rather than the marketing line.

Governed by K.A.T.E., merchant growth tools, intelligence and the guaranteed customer discount all work toward one goal, businesses that genuinely grow by joining the ecosystem.
